Inbound rows add to inbound_msat; every other direction to outbound_msat.
Root groups list the largest first.
The membership digest hashes the sorted membership, independent of row order.
A page starts strictly after its cursor's member.
A cursor read after the quarantine changed is stale.
dependents_cleared lists the waiting rows no longer held.
Without a reprocess the cleared rows are unmeasured, not zero.
Only a current root group can be resolved.
